text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 7: A single day's lag neither detects a planted power loss nor beats a random-day lag'
text.tspan: Figure 7: A single day's lag neither detects a planted power loss nor

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top: the forecasts are re-fitted on a synthetic target in which measured power is cut by 2%, 5%, or 10%, in 9 of the 18 scored months (chosen at random with a fixed seed) and in a random half of the other months. A lag that worked would gain more the bigger the cut. Change in error, L1 minus B0, in percentage points of capacity; more negative is better. Interval: 99%, as for the planned contrasts. Bottom: the change in error from L1 compared with two random-day lags, and from a random-day lag compared with B0 (the change from adding any extra column). Interval: 95%, as for every exploratory contrast.'
text.tspan: Top: the forecasts are re-fitted on a synthetic target in which measured power is cut by 2%, 5%, or 10%, in 9 of
the 18 scored months (chosen at random with a fixed seed) and in a random half of the other months. A lag that
worked would gain more the bigger the cut. Change in error, L1 minus B0, in percentage points of capacity; more
negative is better. Interval: 99%, as for the planned contrasts.
Bottom: the change in error from L1 compared with two random-day lags, and from a random-day lag compared with B0
(the change from adding any extra column). Interval: 95%, as for every exploratory contrast.

text.aria-label: Title text 'Dot: estimate. Line: interval from resampling whole months. Zero: no change. Months being scored are the months the fitted forecasts are tested on. All rows are exploratory. Arms. B0: the baseline with no lag. L1: B0 plus the power at the same hour on the latest whole day before the forecast was issued (two days before the target day for a day-ahead forecast). N1: a random day 8 to 28 days earlier (keeps the plant's slowly changing output level). N2: a random day from months not being scored (a null control).'

Arms. B0: the baseline with no lag. L1: B0 plus the power at the same hour on the latest whole day before the forecast was
